document.description: Valid Canadian visas can unlock visa-free or simplified access beyond passport privileges

unlocks.conditions: Hold a Canadian visa valid on the day of entry into Georgia and present the travel and/or other appropriate document proving its validity. Visa-free stays are limited to 90 calendar days in any 180-day period.

source.verificationPath: Legislative Herald of Georgia > Ordinance No 256 of 5 June 2015 > annex, Canada (item 22), and Notes 1-2
source.exactQuote: Aliens holding a visa and/or a residence permit of any country listed in the annex may enter and stay in Georgia without visa for 90 calendar days in any 180-day period.
source.validityQuote: For the purpose of entering and staying in Georgia without visa, a visa and/or a residence permit of a respective country shall be valid on the day of entry into Georgia (crossing the border), which must be evidenced by a travel and/or other appropriate document.
source.notes: The English page is the initial edition. Checked against the MFA-hosted Georgian consolidated text and the listed 17 April 2025 amendment; that amendment adds conditions for specified Gulf-state documents, not Canadian visas.

currentTextSource.verificationPath: MFA legal-act PDF > page 2, Canada (item 22); page 3, entry conditions 1-3

amendmentSource.verificationPath: Ordinance No 122 of 17 April 2025 > Article 1, addition of condition 3

unlocks.notes: This entry covers Canadian visas. The 90-day allowance is cumulative within any 180 days, not a fresh 90 days per entry. It does not establish permission to work, study or reside in Georgia; other entry requirements still apply.

unlocks.conditions: Hold a valid multiple-entry Canadian visa. The Belize entry-visa exemption is for visits not exceeding 30 days; a single-entry Canadian visa does not meet the stated exemption.

source.verificationPath: Belize Immigration > Visa > Do you need a visa to travel to Belize? > Exemption for Belize Entry Visa for visits not exceeding 30 days
source.exactQuote: If you hold a valid multiple entry visa or Permanent Residence Card from Canada
source.maximumStayQuote: Exemption for Belize Entry Visa for visits not exceeding 30 days.
source.notes: The source lists a valid Canadian multiple-entry visa or Canadian Permanent Residence Card as alternative qualifying documents in the same bullet; this entry records only the visa route. The exemption list does not impose a passport-nationality restriction.

unlocks.notes: This entry covers the Canadian multiple-entry visa exemption, not permanent residence or Canadian eTA. A visa waiver does not waive other admission requirements or guarantee 30 days. Staying beyond the initial 30 days requires the appropriate Belize visitor permit extension.

unlocks.conditions: Hold a valid Canadian visa and a passport valid at entry and throughout the intended stay. The Mexican visa exemption applies regardless of nationality for tourism, business or transit, without engaging in paid activities in Mexico.

source.verificationPath: Consulate General of Mexico in Toronto > Services for foreigners > Visas > Important notice: Travelling to Mexico with a visa and Further information about the process of entering Mexico; Electronic Multiple Migratory Form for Air Travel
source.exactQuote: All foreign visitors, regardless of their nationality, traveling to Mexico for tourism, business or in transit to another destination, are exempt from presenting a Mexican visa as long as they have a valid visa issued by any the following countries: Canada, Japan, the United States of America, the United Kingdom or any of the countries comprising the Schengen Area.
source.maximumStayQuote: allow foreign visitors to remain in Mexico (without engaging in paid activities) for up to 180 days.
source.notes: The government page states Last Updated: 15 August 2025; accessed on 20 October 2026. Its separate linked visitor detail page redirected to a bot challenge and was not used as evidence.

unlocks.notes: This entry covers a Canadian visa, not a Canadian eTA or a work/study permit alone. The visa exemption does not guarantee admission or a 180-day stay: Mexican immigration officers decide admission and the permitted period. Other applicable entry requirements remain in force.

unlocks.conditions: Hold a valid multiple-entry Canadian visa and a valid passport. Entry without a Dominican consular visa applies strictly to tourist visits using a Tourist Card (Tarjeta de Turista); single-entry visas, Canadian eTAs, and work, study, or residence purposes are not covered.

source.verificationPath: MIREX > Portal Unico de Servicios > Servicios > Visas > Decreto Num. 691-07
source.exactQuote: El Decreto Núm. 691-07, del 18 de diciembre de 2007, facilita la entrada a la República Dominicana a extranjeros con residencia permanente o visado de entradas múltiples vigente en Estados Unidos, Unión Europea (Schengen), Canadá o Gran Bretaña. Pueden ingresar solo con pasaporte válido y una Tarjeta de Turismo para fines turísticos.

unlocks.notes: This entry records the Canadian multiple-entry visa exemption under Decreto Núm. 691-07, separately from Canadian permanent residence (recorded in CANADA-pr.json). Entry under this exemption is for tourist purposes with a valid passport and Tourist Card for up to 30 days and does not authorize work, study, or residence.

unlocks.conditions: Hold a valid visa for travel to Canada and present a valid passport. The visa exemption does not guarantee admission; a Border Force Officer determines entry on arrival.

source.verificationPath: Turks and Caicos Islands Border Force > Travel > Entry Requirements > Visa-required travellers
source.exactQuote: However, if you are a lawful resident of the United Kingdom, United States of America, or Canada, or hold a valid visa for travel to any of these three countries, you can enter the Turks and Caicos Islands without a visa.
source.admissionQuote: A Border Force Officer will determine whether you can enter TCI when you arrive.

staySource.verificationPath: GOV.UK > Foreign travel advice > Turks and Caicos Islands > Entry requirements > Visa requirements
staySource.exactQuote: On arrival, the immigration department will normally give you permission to stay for up to 90 days.

unlocks.notes: This entry records the valid Canadian visa route, separately from lawful Canadian residence (recorded in CANADA-pr.json). GOV.UK travel advice states that immigration normally grants up to 90 days on arrival, subject to Border Force determination and standard entry requirements.

unlocks.conditions: Indian nationals holding a valid and current Canadian visa qualify for visa-free tourism visits of up to 30 days.
unlocks.additionalRequirements: Passport valid at least six months beyond the intended stay; return or onward ticket; no derogatory Bureau of Immigration record.

source.verificationPath: PH Visa Policy > Non-Immigrant Visas > Free to enter the Philippines without Visa > Visa Policy for Indian Nationals
source.pageSection: Visa Policy for Indian Nationals: AJACSSUK visas and residence permits

unlocks.notes: Tourism only. The stay cannot be extended or converted to another admission category. This entry covers Indian nationals only.

unlocks.conditions: Nationals of DZ, AZ, BT, CR, CU, EG, SV, GT, HN, IN, JO, KG, LA, MV, MR, MX, MA, NI, PA, PE, TJ, TN, TM, VN holding a valid Canadian entry visa qualify for the 14-day visa exemption.
unlocks.additionalRequirements: Passport valid at least six months; return ticket; confirmed hotel reservation; health insurance; sufficient funds.

source.verificationPath: Visitors > Entry visas > Second group > Full text of the regulations

unlocks.notes: The 14-day stay cannot be extended or converted to a residence visa. Other nationalities and family-member exceptions are outside this entry.

unlocks.conditions: Visa-controlled nationals listed in Bermuda's 2026 Order may present a Canadian multi re-entry visa valid for at least 45 days after intended departure from Bermuda.
unlocks.additionalRequirements: Present a passport and Canadian multi re-entry visa, both valid for at least 45 days after intended departure from Bermuda. Carry proof of a return ticket.

source.exactQuote: has travel authorization to enter and re-enter Canada, the United Kingdom or the United States

additionalSources.verificationPath: Immigration Updates > September 3, 2026 > 2026 Prohibition of Entry Order
additionalSources.exactQuote: a multi-re-entry visa issued by the US, UK or Canada

additionalSources.authority: Government of Bermuda, Department of Immigration
additionalSources.verificationPath: Guidance - Unrestricted Period of Residence > opening paragraph and visitor examples
additionalSources.exactQuote: a cumulative maximum of 180 days in any 12-month period

additionalSources.authority: Government of Bermuda, Department of Immigration
additionalSources.verificationPath: Bermuda entry visas > travel document validity paragraph
additionalSources.exactQuote: the traveler’s passport must be valid for 45 days

additionalSources.authority: Government of Bermuda, Department of Immigration
additionalSources.verificationPath: Update on Services from the Department of Immigration > visitor admission paragraph
additionalSources.exactQuote: provided they have proof of a return ticket

unlocks.notes: Verify whether the 2026 Order's Schedule covers the passport and any applicable exceptions. The 180-day visitor limit is cumulative in a 12-month period. Previous visits can reduce the stay available on entry.

unlocks.conditions: Honduran Category B nationals with a valid Canadian visa qualify for visa-exempt entry for an initial visit of up to 90 days.
unlocks.additionalRequirements: Bring a valid passport, the valid Canadian visa and a return or onward ticket. Immigration may ask for proof of funds, the purpose of travel and an address in Honduras.

source.authority: Honduras Secretariat of Foreign Affairs and International Cooperation
source.verificationPath: Circular No. 008-DSS-ACM-2023 > Section 2 > Visa vigente estadounidense, canadiense o Schengen
source.exactQuote: visa vigente Estadounidense, Canadiense o Schengen, y requieran visa categoría “B”

additionalSources.verificationPath: Ley de Migración y Extranjería > Articles 19 and 20 > means of subsistence and initial stay
additionalSources.exactQuote: se les autorizará permanencia en el país hasta por noventa días

additionalSources.authority: Honduras Aeronautical Information Publication, published by COCESNA
additionalSources.verificationPath: GEN 1.3 > sections 2.1–2.2 and 3.9 > immigration requirements and initial stay

unlocks.notes: The consular circular gives Category C holders of a valid Canadian visa Category B treatment. That group must still obtain a Honduran consular visa.

unlocks.conditions: Ordinary passport holders from India, Indonesia, Laos, Myanmar and Vietnam may apply before travel for a Taiwan Travel Authorization Certificate (TAC) using a qualifying formal Canadian visa. A valid visa or one expired within 10 years of arrival can qualify. Cancelled visas do not qualify.
unlocks.additionalRequirements: The traveler must not have been employed as a blue-collar worker in Taiwan. Carry a printed TAC matching the passport, the qualifying visa or printout of an electronic visa, an ordinary passport valid for at least six months on arrival, and a confirmed return or onward ticket. Complete the online arrival card for subsequent entries using that TAC.

source.verificationPath: Immigration Reference Guide for Civil Carriers > Entry of Aliens > Section 6 > Picture 61, supporting documents table and checkpoints > Canada in the issuing-country table

additionalSources.verificationPath: Online Application for R.O.C. (Taiwan) Travel Authorization Certificate > 2026 eligibility notice
additionalSources.exactQuote: Citizens of India, Indonesia, Laos, Myanmar, and Vietnam can apply online

additionalSources.verificationPath: Online Advance Screening System > TAC heading and current nationality notices

additionalSources.authority: Taiwan National Immigration Agency, hosted by Taiwan's overseas mission
additionalSources.verificationPath: TAC English instructions > basic requirements and stay duration. Use the 2026 BOCA notice for the current passport list.
additionalSources.exactQuote: 14 days, starting from the day after arrival

unlocks.notes: The stay is 14 days from the day after arrival. When the qualifying visa has no expiry date, measure the 10-year window from its issue date. The current BOCA and TAC portal passport list supersedes the older carrier guide list.

unlocks.conditions: Indian nationals transiting to or from a third country may use the 96-hour VFTF with a Canadian visa valid for at least one month from Singapore entry.
unlocks.additionalRequirements: Confirmed onward air, ferry or cruise ticket departing within 96 hours. Entry may be by any transport mode; departure must be by air or sea.

source.verificationPath: Consular services > Visa information > Visa Free Transit Facility (VFTF) > Travellers who are nationals of India
source.pageSection: Indian nationals: valid visa/long-term pass, country list and Germany/Switzerland footnote

unlocks.notes: Transit only; not an unrestricted tourist exemption. ICA decides admission and no extension is allowed. The separate used single-journey-visa return exception is not covered.
